text:
Aisha: Kicking off canary for feature `orchestrator-v2` today. Target deploy window 09:30-10:15 PT. Who's owning the deploy and smoke checks?
Tom: I'm the deploy owner. Plan: start ~09:35. Ramp 5% -> 25% -> 60% over ~30m, smoke at each step. @Marco on smoke.
Marco: On it. Smoke checklist: 1) basic API hits, 2) quick latency dashboard check, 3) inspect logs for 5xx. I'll post results here as I go.
deploy-bot: Pipeline triggered by Tom at 09:36 (build #452). Canary config: cohorts: 5% traffic -> pool-a, 25% -> pool-b, health check interval 30s.
Jin: Oncall infra. I'll watch autoscaler + GPU mem. Rollback criteria: error rate >1% OR sustained p95 >300ms. Ping me if anything odd.
Marco: smoke step 1 done @09:40 — endpoints OK, latency p50 ~45ms, no 5xx. Quick check command I ran: ```curl -sS https://api.redwood/v1/health```
Nora: SRE here — monitoring traces and rollout metrics. Rollback command is `deploy rollback orchestrator-v2`. Tom, do you have a backout plan handy? :eyes:
Tom: Backout plan: revert service weight mappings, scale down new pool, then `kubectl rollout undo deployment/orch-v2` if needed. Runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/orch-v2-backout (step-by-step).
deploy-bot: Canary increased to 25% at 09:50. Watchers: Aisha, Tom, Marco, Jin, Nora.
Marco: smoke step 2 (25%) @09:55 — saw a small p95 bump (~320ms) in one region tied to cache warmup, no increase in errors. Recommend proceed to 60% after 10m guard window.
Jin: Agree to proceed but keep 10m guard window. If p95 stays >300ms after 5m, I'll spin up extra cache nodes as a mitigation.
Aisha: Proceed to 60% after 10m if no >1% errors. If someone triggers rollback, post reason + timestamp here. :thumbsup:
Tom: Rolling to 60% now @10:06. Will update if stable or if I need to rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary now at 60% (10:07). No service-level alerts in the last 2m.
Marco: Final smoke ok. No regressions observed. Plan to merge feature-flag ramp later today (~30m). Good run — will add notes to release doc.
Aisha: Thanks team — appreciate the fast checks. If anything weird overnight, add to the incident board. :tada:
